YOUR NEXT PIECE OF WORK

What deserves
your attention?

Compare three possibilities. Use scores from 1 to 10, and change how much effort matters.

TaskImpactConfidenceEffort

How much should effort count?

Impact and confidence: higher is better. Effort: higher means more work. Scores are your judgments, not predictions.

How the score works

Weighted score = (3 × impact + 2 × confidence + 2 × (11 − effort)) ÷ 7. The result stays on a 1–10 scale.
